# Changelings
[color=#999999][italic]"HELP! THERE'S SOMETHING CHAS--- Nevermind. Everything is fine."[/italic][/color]
A Changeling is an alien creature who assumed the appearance of a regular crewmember. They are a master of disguise, allowing them to assume the identity of any unfortunate victim who has come across one in a secluded area. While their weaknesses imitate those of the identity they took over, they possess the ability to produce [bold]deadly toxins[/bold] within their glands, as well as [bold]shape their body and flesh[/bold] for defensive and offensive purposes.
Changelings are solitary by nature, being generally hostile towards one another and competing over their hunting grounds in attempts to secure as much sustenance as possible.
## The Hunger Never Stops So you are a Changeling that has crawled its way onto the station. What now? As a shapeshifting lifeform, there are a few basic concepts you must understand before you start seeking dinner.
### Assuming Identities Your primary goal as a Changeling is to remain hidden and snack on those delicious so called "coworkers". Thankfully both of those things should be second nature to you... right?
Identities can be obtained in two ways: - [bold]DNA Extraction Sting[/bold], which is completely silent and instantly grants you the identity of the victim. - [bold]Devouring[/bold] the victim, which is loud, messy, but [bold]grants you DNA[/bold] for further evolution.
Keep in mind! A changeling can only have [bold]5 identities[/bold] stored at a time! You cannot devour or extract while at this limit and must purge one of the identities via your transformation menu.
### Evolution Being a scary monster who changes identities is a neat thing, however it is not enough to survive the dangers of space. Thankfully, all those pesky security officers you snacked on will be useful for something. Every time you devour a new crewmember, you obtain a small amount of DNA to spend in the [bold]Evolution Store[/bold]. Here you can buy things like additional abilities to become even more of a threat.
Some of the more interesting picks might include: - [bold]The Armblade[/bold], allowing you to slice up the crew with style. - [bold]Chemical Stings[/bold], to disorient the victim before attacking. - [bold]Horror Form[/bold], a temporary transformation that will allow you to turn the station upside down.
### Resilience Changelings are known for their durability. They [bold]cannot be gibbed or destroyed by any means short of cremation or ashing[/bold].
This by itself wouldn't be so bad, however issues arise when they enter [bold]Regenerative Stasis[/bold].
In this state, they appear completely dead to the outside world, while in reality preparing to jolt back awake with all their injuries gone. Thankfully, the stasis lasts a considerable duration, which further scales based on the amount of damage sustained. Make sure to act quickly when you are in possession of a corpse, or it may get up and stab you in the back.
## Is my coworker a flesh monster? Changelings are vicious creatures, so vicious in fact they leave a huge mess when eating. [bold]They leave small amounts of their viscera when devouring.[/bold] Now, these remains cannot be used by itself for anything, but with help from your chemistry department you can synthesize a chemical that irritates Changelings, causing them to shake and yell out upon injection.
Alternatively, if you don't care about having your boss eaten by a scary flesh monster, it can be repurposed into chemicals that can [bold]reverse rotting[/bold] on the corpse you just found!
Note. The availability of the tissue is [bold]greatly limited[/bold] due to the small amounts produced by live changelings. Use what you manage to gather wisely!
